problem: McKay conjecture : in a group G {\displaystyle G} , the number of irreducible complex characters of degree not divisible by a prime number p {\displaystyle p} is equal to the number of irreducible complex characters of the normalizer of any Sylow p {\displaystyle p} -subgroup within G {\displaystyle G} .
